title_zh: 把实验图表结论限制在观察范围内

scenario.label_zh: 修订课堂实验结果说明
scenario.goal_zh: 依据所给实验图表区分观察与概括，并补充报告的限制

context_zh: 阿米拉与老师讨论一份虚构课堂练习的现成图表，没有实际培养微生物或操作化学品。
author: author-phase06-c

sentences.speaker: Student Amira
sentences.text: My conclusion says the acid killed all the bacteria. Does that match the chart?

sentences.speaker: Teacher Lewis
sentences.text: Look at the heading. The chart shows slower growth in one sample, not the death of every organism.

sentences.speaker: Student Amira
sentences.text: So I have described something that was not measured.

sentences.speaker: Teacher Lewis
sentences.text: Exactly. A balanced report should explain both the result and what this single test cannot tell us.

sentences.speaker: Student Amira
sentences.text: I will write that growth was slower in this sample and remove the claim that everything died.

sentences.speaker: Teacher Lewis
sentences.text: Good. Also identify the sample and time period given in the worksheet.

sentences.speaker: Student Amira
sentences.text: I will add those details and say that we cannot generalize from this one chart.

targets.sense_zh: 全面而不过度偏向某一方面的
